Clearer energy numbers on the Diary. Install it over 1.0.7; your data stays.

**[Download Spectra.apk](https://github.com/m0n0t0ne0ne/spectra/releases/download/v1.0.8/Spectra.apk)**

### Energy card
- **No more repeated number.** When your target equals what you burned (Maintain, with the target set from your weight goal), Over target always matched Surplus. That tile now shows **Protein left** (or your protein total once you hit it). On Lose or Gain, or with a target you typed, it still shows Over target or Left to eat.
- **Burned › shows which weigh-in a day uses**, for example "BMR uses your 138.4 lb weigh-in from Sat, Nov 7, the latest one before this day."
- On past days, the summary sentence says "that day" instead of "today".
